arcane-blast.description:
Deal 100 damage, then empower your further arcane blasts to deal 40% increased damage and have 25% increased cast speed, but cost 20 extra mana.

Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage also gain the damage bonus. Arcane Barrage and Evocation will remove the damage bonus. Max 4 stacks.

arcane-missiles.description:
While channeling, deals 90 damage every 0.5 seconds. Also has a 20% chance each hit to reduce cooldown of Evocation by 1 second.

Arcane Missiles has a 20% chance to become usable when you hit with Arcane Blast and a 40% chance with Arcane Barrage.

arcane-barrage.description: Instantly deal 180 damage and remove all stacks of Arcane Blast.

evocation.description: Recover 600 mana over 10 seconds. Removes all stacks of Arcane Blast on cast.

power-surge.description: Grants 40% more damage, but spells cost 40% more mana. Lasts 15 seconds.

arcane-blast.description: All your spells deal 40% increased damage. Arcane Blast also has 25% increased cast speed, but costs 20 extra mana.

power-surge.description: Your spells deal 40% more damage, but cost 40% more mana.
